website.note: Confirms tafenoquine (ARAKODA) commercial product plus Phase 2 babesiosis programs and earlier-stage candidiasis/fungal program; celgosivir listed at preliminary development stage

pipeline.target: Plasmodium and Babesia parasites (mitochondrial / multi-stage activity)
pipeline.license_origin: Originated by Walter Reed Army Institute of Research / GlaxoSmithKline; commercialized for malaria prophylaxis (ARAKODA) and developed by 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals for babesiosis and other indications

indications.indication: Acute babesiosis (oral tafenoquine + standard of care vs placebo + standard of care)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral tafenoquine plus standard of care in babesiosis
Phase 2 study of tafenoquine 100 mg in chronic babesiosis

commercial_product.indication: Prevention of malaria in adults and adolescents (FDA-approved 2019; KODATEF in Australia)

excluded_preclinical: Tafenoquine for fungal diseases / candidiasis — described as Phase 2A program on company site but no public NCT identified

Celgosivir (host-targeted alpha-glucosidase inhibitor) for dengue / RSV / COVID-19 — preliminary development stage per company; no active 60P-sponsored NCT (only WITHDRAWN Singapore General Hospital-led NCT02569827)
excluded_legacy_terminated: Tafenoquine in mild-to-moderate COVID-19 (NCT04533347) — Phase 2 COMPLETED
Tafenoquine long-term safety study (NCT03320174) — Phase 2 COMPLETED
Celgosivir/Modipafant for dengue (NCT02569827, Singapore General Hospital lead) — WITHDRAWN
